scores.evidence_span: a strategic choice that goes beyond university prestige; it dictates your working style, funding structure, and long-term career trajectory
scores.rationale: Identifies fit-related considerations and career consequences beyond prestige, but does not explicitly establish evidence-based comparison as the decision priority. The partial-evidence cap applies.

scores.evidence_span: [AI PhD Stipends by Country](https://relocateatlas.com/blog/ai-phd-stipend-by-country) - Analysis of AI PhD compensation models, cost of living ratios, and European salaried structures.
scores.rationale: Identifies a source and its relevant evidence classes for comparing financial outcomes and funding trade-offs.

scores.evidence_span: The Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS) provides an annual stipend of ~US$44,150 plus travel allowances [citation:Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme](https://cerg1.ugc.edu.hk/hkpfs/index.html).
scores.rationale: Provides a concrete, verifiable funding fact about a named option, supported by an official source, that can inform financial comparison.
No named option or route is shown through a concrete fact to embody prestige as the dominant decision rule.

scores.evidence_span: a strategic choice that goes beyond university prestige; it dictates your working style, funding structure, and long-term career trajectory
scores.rationale: Contrasts prestige with practical considerations only at a general level. It does not directly compare the two decision rules on a common axis and establish a consequential difference. The partial-evidence cap applies.

scores.evidence_span: Do you want structured coursework to explore (US), or do you want to dive straight into a hyper-specific niche (Europe)?
scores.rationale: Links named regional routes to working-style fit, but leaves selection as a question rather than recommending an option because of an evidence-based comparison. The partial-evidence cap applies.
No otherwise viable named option is downgraded because its selection would prioritize prestige.

scores.evidence_span: Track faculty whose recent papers align with your interests.
scores.rationale: Provides an executable program-selection action using identifiable research evidence to assess fit.

scores.evidence_span: Build a list of 10-15 programs balancing reach, target, and safety options. Track faculty whose recent papers align with your interests.
scores.rationale: Provides a numerical shortlist allocation alongside a fit-oriented action, but does not define an evidence-based fit, outcome, or trade-off threshold for inclusion or prioritization. The partial-evidence cap applies.
No concrete condition is given under which prestige should become the dominant decision rule.

scores.evidence_span: Decide which system fits your working style. Do you want structured coursework to explore (US), or do you want to dive straight into a hyper-specific niche (Europe)?
scores.rationale: Visibly links working-style fit to concrete differences between regional structures and then to system selection. The chain is explicit but limited to conditional structural fit rather than a completed comparison incorporating outcomes and trade-offs.
